label: Prefix X
tagline: prepend an X gate on a chosen qubit
description: Adds an X gate at the beginning of the circuit on the target qubit. Doesn't change qubit count or anything else; useful for sanity-checking a downstream simulator's measurement statistics.
author: QuDA Studio SDK example

params.label: Target qubit
params.hint: Index of the qubit to apply X to before the rest of the circuit.
